profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Charles Schwab
profile.summary:
I develop full-stack web applications across a variety of JavaScript frameworks. 

Skills:

Javascript   •  React  •  CSS  •  Accessibility  •  Node.js  •  Express  •  Jest  •  Cypress  •. Splunk  •  Jenkins  •  D3  •  Git •  Vite  •  HTML  •  Python  •  MongoDB  •  Mongoose  •  SQL  •  Sequelize  •  Mocha/Chai  •  AWS

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Develop front-end data visualizations and software solutions using React and Redux for the Thinkorswim web application
• Serve as team Security Champion, ensuring security best practices are employed throughout Thinkorswim
• Act as team Accessibility Champion, developing and maintaining a11y features to ensure all clients have a smooth user experience

positions.title: Senior Software Developer, Technical Lead
positions.description:
• Served as Technical Lead for one of the TDAx teams, developing the tdameritrade.com responsive web application
• Employed a variety of data sources, including microservices, internal APIs, and vendor services to create use cases and presentation models for the React frontend
• Created React components using advanced patterns and hooks
• Managed responsive layouts and styles using Sass
• Developed custom forms workflow to accommodate money movement between accounts, including internal transfers, ACH, and wires
• Refreshed tdameritrade.com homepage with a new dashboard experience designed to put the most relevant client data (balances, positions, orders, news) front and center
• Led accessibility initiatives to make tdameritrade.com WCAG 2.0 compliant

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Engineered the workflow and logic for multi-leg option strategies on TD Ameritrade’s core trading website
• Developed mobile web solutions using React and CSS modules that allow users to trade stocks and ETFs across multiple accounts
• Wrote automated unit and integration tests with Jest, Enzyme, Selenium, and Cypress, utilizing Jenkins for continuous delivery

positions.title: Consultant, Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed full-stack JavaScript solutions for the National Institutes of Health using React, AngularJS, Node.js, Webpack, and MySQL
• Created RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express
• Managed data visualizations with D3 to help clients make data-driven decisions
• Evaluated client needs and determined relevant technology solutions to meet business goals

positions.title: Director of Client Services
positions.description:
• Led the project management team, overseeing 60+ projects across web, iOS, and Android
• Managed technical projects for iOS and Android apps that have millions of users
• Analyzed client needs and presented technology solutions to address business goals
• Oversaw design, content, and development of the Gloto.com website
• Maintained staging and live versions of app media content using Git for version control
• Developed and maintained key business partnerships with major brands, including the NBA, NBCUniversal, Unilever, TBS, Wyndham Hotels, Garmin, and Bose
• Composed project proposals and statements of work to support new and ongoing business

positions.title: Software Project Manager
positions.description:
• Managed project timelines and ensured timely delivery of finished products
• Created final reports for social campaigns that incorporated analytics and data visualizations
• Wrote blog posts on marketing technology trends and how to use Gloto applications

positions.title: Director of Media Marketing
positions.description:
• Led all media marketing projects and initiatives, including email, video, and social media projects
• Managed a major website redesign to support direct-to-consumer sales for hundreds of products
•  Advised on UI/UX and feature roadmap for iPhone and iPad software
• Taught software training seminars across North America on how to use OakTree applications
• Utilized Google Analytics to optimize visitor experiences and increase sales conversions

projects.title: Ames Housing Regression Analysis
projects.description:
- Designed a linear regression model using Python and pandas to determine statistically significant variables that contribute towards final home sale prices

- Utilized Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Scikit-learn libraries to visualize patterns and trends in the data

projects.title: Accordance for Windows Video
projects.description: This video announces the native Windows version of Accordance. After nearly 20 years of being Mac native, we wanted to create something fun and memorable to announce the new Windows version. I wrote the script, provided the voice over, and collaborated with the producer on the storyboard. The triplet effect is courtesy of the producer's camera magic.
